launch.title: Launch config
launch.contextSizeHint: Set the context window size of the model, larger values will use more memory.
launch.variantHint: Choose the runtime variant used to start this model. The store currently ships only the standard runtime.
launch.variantStandardHint: Standard llama.cpp runtime with turbo3/turbo4 KV cache quantization support.
launch.cacheTypeKHint: Main model K KV cache data type, maps to --cache-type-k.
launch.cacheTypeVHint: Main model V KV cache data type, maps to --cache-type-v.
launch.temperatureHint: Maps to --temp. Higher values make output more random. Defaults to the model manifest temperature.
launch.topPHint: Maps to --top-p. Nucleus sampling cutoff probability. Defaults to the model manifest top_p.
launch.topKHint: Maps to --top-k. Limits candidate token count. Defaults to the model manifest top_k.
launch.repeatPenaltyHint: Maps to --repeat-penalty. Higher values reduce repetition. Defaults to the model manifest repeat_penalty.
launch.minPHint: Maps to --min-p. Low-probability token cutoff. Defaults to the model manifest min_p.
launch.parallelHint: Number of parallel request slots, maps to -np. Empty means auto.
launch.batchSizeHint: Prompt processing batch size, maps to --batch-size. Empty means auto.
launch.ubatchSizeHint: Physical micro-batch size, maps to --ubatch-size. Empty means auto.
launch.gpuLayersHint: Layers offloaded to GPU, maps to -ngl. Empty means hardware auto-detection.
launch.threadsHint: CPU threads for generation, maps to --threads. Empty means auto.
launch.threadsBatchHint: CPU threads for batching, maps to --threads-batch. Empty means auto.
launch.cacheRamHint: Maps to --cache-ram. -1 means unlimited, 0 disables it, and a positive value is the maximum cache size in MiB.
launch.noMmapHint: Maps to --no-mmap. Reads model files without mmap, which is often more compatible with Windows file-locking and permissions, but can increase startup memory use.
launch.contBatchingHint: Maps to --cont-batching. Lets llama.cpp queue and interleave multiple requests to improve throughput; per-request latency and VRAM use may increase slightly.
launch.noKvOffloadHint: Maps to --no-kv-offload. Keeps KV cache on CPU/system memory instead of GPU; saves VRAM but is usually slower.
launch.dflashHint: Shown only for the standard llama.cpp variant when the model supports DFlash. Loads an extra draft model with draft-dflash speculative decoding.
launch.dflashGpuLayersHint: Layers offloaded to GPU for the DFlash draft model, maps to --gpu-layers-draft.
launch.dflashDraftMinHint: Minimum DFlash draft tokens, maps to --spec-draft-n-min.
launch.dflashDraftMaxHint: Maximum DFlash draft tokens, maps to --spec-draft-n-max.
launch.mtpHint: Shown for standard llama.cpp models that support MTP. MTP is mutually exclusive with DFlash and N-gram speculative decoding.
launch.mtpDraftMaxHint: Maximum MTP draft tokens, maps to --spec-draft-n-max. Range: 1 to 16.
launch.ngramHint: Adds N-gram speculative decoding arguments when enabled. Off by default; leave it off unless you want to tune it.
launch.specNgramSizeNHint: For ngram-mod, maps to --spec-ngram-mod-n-match. Default is 24.
launch.draftMinHint: For ngram-mod, maps to --spec-ngram-mod-n-min. Default is 48.
launch.draftMaxHint: For ngram-mod, maps to --spec-ngram-mod-n-max. Default is 64.
